caption: The drawing displays a cross comprised of a vertical and a horizontal rectangular bar intersecting at their centers. The cross sections are bordered in grey and filled with an off-white or cream color. Decorative elements within the cross sections include light yellow, pink, and orange shapes; the vertical bar displays floral-like motifs with concentric shapes, and both bars feature wavy lines and curved accents in pink and orange along with yellow heart-like forms. At the intersection of the bars, there is a large, centrally placed circular metal ornament, grey in color, adorned with a series of small round protrusions along its circumference and a smaller circular boss in the center. The tips or ends of each bar are squared, and the drawing is placed on a plain, light beige background. There is handwritten text at the bottom right corner that reads "Matez G. Claflin-Taos-NM."
title: Tin & Wall Paper Cross
